mapper.select: SELECT message.*, u1.`username` as senderName, u1.`avatar_url` as senderAvatar, u2.`username` as receiverName, u2.`avatar_url` as receiverAvatar FROM message, users u1, users u2 WHERE u1.uid = message.sender and u2.uid = message.receiver and message.sender = #{sender} ORDER BY message.create_time DESC
